content.text:
Your weight isn't on file — and there's no way to give an *exact* protein target in grams without it, since it's calculated per kg of bodyweight. So I can't skip this one.

What do you weigh (kg)? Drop me that number and I'll get you a precise gram target from the nutritionist right away. In the meantime, the ballpark for muscle recovery from strength training is 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day — so if you're, say, 75 kg, that's roughly 120–165 g/day. Give me the actual number and I'll get you the specific figure.
